PBRify models shipped in the APK as the assets pbrify-normal-int8.onnx and pbrify-height-int8.onnx, int8 versions of
PBRify's normal and height networks, for the relief maps the game makes on the device (src/libs/relief).

Author:    Kim2091, PBRify_Remix (https://github.com/Kim2091/PBRify_Remix): the SPAN models 1x-PBRify_NormalV3 and
           1x-PBRify_Height, released under CC0-1.0 (PBRify-CC0-1.0.txt).
Export:    ONNX re-exports of those models by fernandotonon, QtMeshEditor-models
           (https://huggingface.co/fernandotonon/QtMeshEditor-models), revision
           b35b7f4c924936803bf79e868302d7f8f643d302, listed there as CC0-1.0. I/O 1x3xHxW float 0..1, free size.
Files:     1x-PBRify_NormalV3.onnx, 1640690 bytes,
           sha256 19d78f555f994219e2692876ab0fb6c3e4382503952dbe72d74db89d24870ba4
           1x-PBRify_Height.onnx, 1640690 bytes,
           sha256 2b14afd583148cb5b0a554bf86a009b6a898aadc00d213aa3ec2544e17c835f5
           (checked by make_models.py when it downloads them)
Modified:  by src/libs/relief/model/make_models.py: weights and activations quantised to int8 (static QDQ, per-channel
           weights, calibrated on procedural textures generated by the script; no game data), unused nodes dropped.
           Results (checked at build time):
           pbrify-normal-int8.onnx, 501397 bytes,
           sha256 fc91ce30e48deaf5847ed19342bd1fc7a8ffc11a2ec94f26c4d6bcbe63df4b33
           pbrify-height-int8.onnx, 501394 bytes,
           sha256 01f251dc40e79fa7ef5348b51f538de5a14bc6113c8ea3173ba78ce0b648c409
           The modified files stay CC0-1.0.
Use:       run with onnxruntime (MIT, onnxruntime-MIT.txt) on the player's device, in the game process.
